manifest_title: CrisisRoute Empirical Reproducibility & Claim Provenance Manifest

scientific_claims.formal_statement: Post-hoc isotonic calibration reduces Expected Calibration Error (ECE) by >= 30% without degrading ROC-AUC ranking.
Risk-aware Dijkstra routing reduces route severance rate by >= 40% under ground-truth hazards vs Shortest-Time nominal routing.
OR-Tools CP-SAT formulation guarantees 100% compliance with vulnerable group service floor alpha and minimizes Gini inequality.
scientific_claims.verified_numerical_value: Floor compliance CP-SAT 100% vs greedy 100%; mean Gini 0.0102 vs greedy 0.5968 (30 perturbed instances)
scientific_claims.threshold_condition: CP-SAT floor compliance = 100% and (Gini cut >= 25% or Gini <= 0.15)

scientific_claims.paper_section: Section 4.4: Active Reconnaissance Value of Information
scientific_claims.formal_statement: Analytic EVPI of reconnaissance targets correlates with Monte Carlo simulated regret reduction (r > 0.40, p < 0.05).
System degrades gracefully under 5 out of 5 adversarial stress scenarios, returning Minimal Infeasible Subsystem (IIS) diagnostics.
scientific_claims.verified_numerical_value: 5/5 stress scenarios verified with structured failure mode diagnostics

hypothesis_tests.description: Isotonic calibration reduces held-out ECE by >= 30% preserving ROC-AUC

details.evaluation: test events 11-12, model trained on events 1-8, calibrated on 9-10
details.p_value_method: paired bootstrap on ECE, 1000 resamples, one-sided

hypothesis_tests.description: Risk-aware Dijkstra reduces route severance rate by >= 40% vs Shortest-Time

details.p_value_method: exact McNemar (binomial) test on paired severance outcomes
details.instance_note: designed instance: one fragile fast road, other links reliable

hypothesis_tests.description: CP-SAT achieves 100% alpha-floor compliance and lowers Gini vs greedy

details.metric: Gini of per-node fulfilment ratios (0 = perfectly equal)

hypothesis_tests.description: EVPI-guided inspection saves more simulated minutes than random (p < 0.01)

details.ground_truth: independent Monte Carlo of commit-or-detour decision

stress_tests.adversarial_condition: 80% of primary and secondary road corridors severed by landslides
stress_tests.system_behavior: Detected isolated demand clusters without crashing; returned structured IIS explanation.

stress_tests.adversarial_condition: Total relief demand exceeds depot inventories by > 300%
stress_tests.system_behavior: Detected exact multi-commodity stock shortfalls and returned IIS deficit explanation.

stress_tests.adversarial_condition: Single small 350kg vehicle tasked with multi-ton corridor demand
stress_tests.system_behavior: Identified fleet payload capacity deficit and recommended vehicle reinforcement.

stress_tests.adversarial_condition: Contradictory status reports on critical bridge with stale evidence
stress_tests.system_behavior: ObservationGraphManager detected conflict; widened uncertainty interval and safely diverted traffic.

stress_tests.adversarial_condition: 100% of demand clusters are vulnerable clinics with strict alpha=0.60 service floor
stress_tests.system_behavior: Enforced protective alpha-floor prioritizations across all vulnerable nodes.
